name: Buriram Marathon Presented by Chang Mineral
short_description: A full and half marathon held at the Chang International Circuit in Buriram, Thailand on January 23, 2027.
ai_summary: The Buriram Marathon Presented by Chang Mineral takes place on January 23, 2027, at the Chang International Circuit in Buriram, Thailand. The event offers both a full marathon (42.195 km) and a half marathon (21.1 km) distance for participants to choose from. Registration for this race is currently open.

faqs.question: When is the Buriram Marathon Presented by Chang Mineral?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on January 23, 2027. It is held in Buriram, Thailand, at the Chang International Circuit venue. Runners planning to participate should mark this date on their calendars and register while registration remains open.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose between two distances: a full marathon of 42.195 kilometers and a half marathon of 21.1 kilometers. This gives runners of different experience levels and training backgrounds the option to select the distance that best suits their goals.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Buriram Marathon Presented by Chang Mineral is held at the Chang International Circuit, located in Buriram, Thailand. This venue serves as the host site for both the full marathon and half marathon distances offered as part of this event.

faqs.question: Is registration currently open?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Buriram Marathon Presented by Chang Mineral is currently open. Interested runners looking to participate in either the full marathon or half marathon distance can sign up now ahead of the January 23, 2027 race date.
